rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for a university student who has not yet graduated.

example.english: My younger brother is still an undergraduate and hasn't graduated yet.
example.traditional: 我細佬而家仲係大學生，未畢業。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 lou2 ji4 gaa1 zung6 hai6 daai6 hok6 saang1 mei6 bat1 jip6
